coverage_policy: Measured: owned parser-seam requests, wrapper/Python attempts, artifacts and outcomes; fullsource/snippet/validation and target/external/unattributed are distinct. Uninstrumented: third-party/generated/startup direct ast.parse, direct annotation and V-series bypasses, native retries inside ts_parse. No parallel or cross-command claim. Pinned fullsource physical inputs must match a declared clean source variant (no BOM/compat rewrite qualified here). Full command JSON is retained; only the copied corpus prefix is normalized. A null tree-sitter distribution version explicitly means absent/bundled distribution; the language-pack version is still required. Runtime/version metadata must repeat across five current runs; historical versions are provenance, not ceilings. A fresh-process serial observer rejects Python audited fork/subprocess/posix_spawn launches and multiprocessing BaseProcess.start; native launches outside those hooks are not qualified. Request/attempt/artifact/failure counts are ceilings; successful built/cached outcomes remain full ledger evidence without preventing improved reuse. New parser/domain/content request identities still fail the accepted ceilings.
